summary: On May 6, 2026, SuperX AI Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of Mr. Frank Han as executive director, effective immediately. The resignation was not due to any disagreement with the board or management. Mr. Han will cease all board and executive roles. No terms, consideration, or advisors are mentioned as this is a standard resignation notice. The filing is a routine disclosure of a director departure under Form 6-K. Watch for any subsequent changes in leadership or company strategy following this unexpected exit.
